cards.lore: Nietzsche was right. The state is a cold-blooded monster that only exists to maintain its own power.
cards.power: Absorb 10 Freedom tokens from all players. You now hold the Monopoly on Violence.

cards.lore: Two identical parties ensure the masses can throw the rascals out without changing the policy.
cards.power: Target player wastes 2 turns arguing with themselves. Nothing changes.

cards.lore: Mussolini called it corporatism; the postmodern technocrats call it a Public Private Partnership.
cards.power: Merge your Bank deck with your Government deck. Evade all antitrust attacks.

cards.lore: Progressive reforms from the ivory tower only serve to disempower the population that pays for them.
cards.power: Play this to cancel any player's action, citing missing paperwork.

cards.lore: Five billion people fall into poverty while the elite double their fortunes. The Ponzi scheme works perfectly.
cards.power: Transfer 73.85% of target's assets to the player with the most wealth.

cards.lore: Trapped in a suffocating corset of subscriptions, streaming, and licenses for things you used to own.
cards.power: You own nothing. Pay 1 token every turn just to keep your cards in your hand.

cards.lore: The normal citizen battles rising taxes and energy costs, left with neither time nor money for a life of dignity.
cards.power: Discard your hand. It's worthless now anyway.

cards.lore: The 148 largest corporations record 1.8 trillion in profits while lecturing you on your carbon footprint.
cards.power: Steal an opponent's resources under the guise of saving the forest.

cards.lore: Continuous rapid-fire multimedia propaganda melts traditional thought patterns into compliance.
cards.power: Target player forgets their strategy and loses 1 Intelligence token.

cards.lore: As the 1994 US Special Forces manual notes: if the situation is explosive, any historical event can be weaponized as a trigger.
cards.power: Play instantly to turn any random minor action into a global crisis.

cards.lore: The rich pay, provide credibility, and the poor are sent to the front lines to die.
cards.power: Force a poorer player to fight your battles. You take the loot, they take the damage.

cards.lore: Sow discord, disorganization, and subversion. A divided resistance is a defeated resistance.
cards.power: Divide an opponent's allied cards. They now attack each other.

cards.lore: A bloodthirsty, postmodern rule of terror masked as public health.
cards.power: Lock down the board. No one can play cards without a Medical Compliance token.

cards.lore: Since Robert Koch's colonial camps, the state has never truly stopped treating citizens as guinea pigs.
cards.power: Ignore all ethical rules of the game for the next 3 turns.

cards.lore: In 1953, the CIA fed thousands of unsuspecting citizens LSD to break the human mind.
cards.power: Target player must play their hand randomly with their eyes closed.

cards.lore: For 20 years, the state tested tularemia, typhus, yellow fever, and anthrax on its own.
cards.power: Release a pathogen. All players discard their highest-value card.

cards.lore: For forty years (1932-1972), therapies were intentionally withheld from minorities for study purposes.
cards.power: Slowly drain 1 token from an opponent every turn. You may not tell them why.

cards.lore: Sarin, mustard gas, and VX tested on 100,000 unwitting soldiers who thought they had bugs under their skin.
cards.power: Paralyze an opponent's deck for 1 turn.

cards.lore: Soldiers ordered to drive over radioactive barrels in Hanford, just to see if the trucks offered protection.
cards.power: Irradiate a zone. Any card played there is instantly destroyed.

cards.lore: Sick children in Oak Ridge blasted with massive radiation, not to cure them, but to see how much astronauts could survive.
cards.power: Sacrifice a weak card to gain +5 Science Points for the Empire.

cards.lore: From the US to Sweden to Canada, the state legally erased the futures of indigenous and undesirable women.
cards.power: Target opponent cannot draw new cards for 2 turns.

cards.lore: 166 million UK pounds funded forced sterilization camps in India, justified as fighting climate change.
cards.power: Destroy an opponent's population token. Claim it was to lower greenhouse gases.

cards.lore: A UN strategy from 2000 to compensate for declining birth rates rates through orchestrated migration.
cards.power: Swap one of your weak cards with an opponent's strong card to balance demographics.

cards.lore: Migrants and citizens are both victims, pushed into violent friction by the faceless supranational empire.
cards.power: Incite a riot. Both you and your opponent lose 2 cards.

cards.lore: Instead of work camps, we have algorithms silencing dissent before it can even be spoken.
cards.power: Look at opponent's hand. Discard any card you deem disinformation.

cards.lore: Chat control, digital currency, and AI overlords converge to end freedom centimeter by centimeter.
cards.power: Track an opponent. You can see their cards for the rest of the game.

cards.lore: By 2027, AI in your own car will permanently monitor you. The 4th industrial revolution is a physical threat.
cards.power: Your vehicles now spy on their drivers. Gain +1 Intel per turn.

cards.lore: Born, indoctrinated, exploited, and buried. Individual development is not included in this off-the-rack life plan.
cards.power: Skip your turn. You are too busy watching streaming services.

cards.lore: The masses must rally around the flag. Conformist collectivism is the ultimate goal. Critical questions equal treason.
cards.power: Force all players to play the exact same suit/faction this turn.

cards.lore: Exactly where the state wants the resistance: ground down, discouraged, powerless, and depressed.
cards.power: You are exhausted. Maximum hand size reduced to 3.

cards.lore: The citizen is nothing more than a guinea pig for the pharmacological-financial complex.
cards.power: Pay 5 tokens to Big Pharma or lose 2 Health.

cards.lore: Berlin, Brussels, London, New York, or Beijing: just different facades of the same Potemkin Village.
cards.power: Create a fake defense wall. It shatters the moment it is attacked.

cards.lore: Global Governance is controlled by the same cartels and families that have dictated history for generations.
cards.power: You control the money supply. Change the cost of any card in play.

cards.lore: Heads are no longer chopped off, but washed. Postmodern tyranny just hides behind a rainbow pluralism simulation.
cards.power: Attack an opponent, but gain +5 Public Relations points.

cards.lore: Philanthropy is the ultimate mask for extracting global wealth and implementing population control.
cards.power: Give an opponent 1 token, then steal 5.

cards.lore: The Pax Americana is enforced at all costs, discarding laws, morals, and collateral damage.
cards.power: Start a proxy war on the board. All other players must discard their hands.

cards.lore: Every empire falls. History teaches us that grotesque excesses of power eventually choke on the power of the many.
cards.power: If the ruling player has 10x the wealth of the poorest, trigger a board wipe.

cards.lore: It is always the same civilizational process. First the bureaucracy, then the police state, then the pitchforks.
cards.power: All poor players unite their attack power against the wealthiest player.

cards.lore: Eventually, even the most conformist statist realizes the politico-media farce has nothing to do with their actual reality.
cards.power: Reveal all hidden cards. Cancel all active Psy-Ops.

cards.lore: A phase of freedom is followed by institutional decay, corruption, and obscenities.
cards.power: The rules of the game slowly break down. Players can ignore 1 rule per turn.

cards.lore: Humor is the universal remedy to wring a fulfilled life out of dark times. A free life.
cards.power: Laugh at an attack. Negate all damage and draw a card.

cards.lore: Self-determined individuals have the mental capacity to see right through the political-financial Ponzi scheme.
cards.power: You are immune to Propaganda and Psy-Op cards.

cards.lore: Being against something is easy. We need stories of a freely organized future to inspire the next generation.
cards.power: Change the win condition of the game for all players.

cards.lore: We fight not just for freedom of speech, but for the preservation of human free will against the Monster.
cards.power: You cannot be forced to skip a turn or discard cards by opponent effects.

cards.lore: Because even anarchy needs a layout.
cards.power: Shuffle these 52 Kayfabe Kards into the main Kult Klub deck. Trust no one.

cards.lore: Everything is upside down. Doctors destroy health, governments destroy freedom.
cards.power: If a rule on these cards contradicts the main game, this card wins. The State always cheats.

cards.lore: Freedom is a state of mind, not an organizational problem.
cards.power: Play this card to immediately end the game in a tie. Everyone goes outside.
